articles.summary: Mobile charging leader finalizes take-private merger at $1.25 per ADS. Consortium includes key executives. See transaction timeline and premium details.

articles.summary: Chinese mobile charging firm Energy Monster receives $1.77/ADS buyout offer from Hillhouse, following earlier merger agreement with Trustar Capital and management on Aug 1.
articles.title: Smart Share Global Limited Announces Receipt of a Preliminary Non-Binding Proposal to Acquire the Company from Hillhouse
